instruction: An eye-level full shot of four friends posing together in a grassy park. Standing side-by-side from left to right, they spell out the word 'TEAM' with their shirts. On the far left, the East Asian man in a red t-shirt with a yellow letter T (R3) points to his shirt. Next to him, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt with a red letter E (R4) raises her left arm. Beside her, the woman with an afro in a red t-shirt with a pink letter A (R6) stands with arms outstretched. On the far right, the bald man in a dark blue t-shirt with a light blue letter M (R2) smiles with arms wide. The group stands on green grass with trees in the background under bright daylight.
elements: R3 points to the letter T on his own shirt while R4 raises her left arm
R4 raises her left arm while R6 stands with both arms outstretched
R2 smiles with arms wide while R3 points to his shirt
The shirts display letters that spell TEAM
The group is in a grassy park with trees in bright daylight

questions.q: Is R3 the one pointing to the letter T on his own shirt while R4 raises her left arm, rather than R4 pointing to the T shirt and R3 raising her left arm?
questions.element: R3 points to the letter T on his own shirt while R4 raises her left arm

questions.q: Does R4 raise her left arm while R6 stands with both arms outstretched, rather than R6 raising only her left arm and R4 standing with both arms outstretched?
questions.element: R4 raises her left arm while R6 stands with both arms outstretched

questions.q: Is R2 the one smiling with arms wide while R3 points to his shirt, rather than R3 being the one with arms wide and R2 pointing to his shirt?
questions.element: R2 smiles with arms wide while R3 points to his shirt

questions.q: Does R6 stand with her arms outstretched?
